name: First Fruits
overview: The biblical concept of First Fruits centers on offering the initial yield of crops and produce to the Lord as a sacred act of dedication and gratitude. Scripture commands that the first of the ripe fruits, grain, and other offerings be brought to the house of the Lord and presented without delay, emphasizing their purity and the importance of honoring God with the best and earliest of the harvest (Exodus 22:29; 23:19; 34:26). These offerings, though not always consumed on the altar, were to be seasoned with salt as a symbol of the covenant, underscoring the solemnity of the act (Leviticus 2:12-14). This practice foreshadows the believer’s call to give God the first and best of all they possess, acknowledging His provision and lordship.
